verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents official SDKs for Rust (`helix-db` 3.0.0 crate), TypeScript (`@helix-db/helix-db` 3.1.0), Go and Python (`helix-db` 0.3.4 on PyPI). Each has its own setup guide, all share one operation-tree request model, and the docs cover typed HTTP clients, an embedded client and structured error metadata. The same SDK tooling works across local, embedded and Cloud deployments. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage, and a published version number for the Go SDK.
